snippet.title: Village in the Shade -  Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Village in the Shade releases for Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, and PC on October 27, 2026.

Welcome to Kagatsu, a beautiful mountain town in rural Japan perfect for a change of pace! Meet the local townsfolk, hunt, mine, plant crops, and explore this brand-new, hand-painted farming sim.

Just don't go out at night. You never know who (or what) you'll run into...

This is quiet, countryside living...as long as you follow the rules.

Follow @NISAmerica on X, Instagram, and Facebook for updates! 
Learn more @ https://www.nisamerica.com/village-in-the-shade/

#VillageintheShade
